name: Cargotrans Maritime Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2012, Cargotrans Maritime Ltd is in the business of Ocean Freight Forwarding and Transportation Services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) CTML is an international logistics solutions provider with core business of providing sea logistics services including ocean freight forwarding (FCL and LCL), transportation, custom clearance, warehousing, and other value-added services to the clients. 
b) It is also in the business of freight forwarding
c) Company has 100% stake in Cargotrans Maritime Agencies Private Limited and in Cargotrans Maritime Forwarding Private Limited which helps customhouse agent service and coastal transportation (i.e. transport of goods through sea within India)

cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -32.0%
